description: Public: the demo accounts to sign in as, and the shop name. No session needed.

Public: sign in as a demo account. Sets the session cookie (rc_session: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure in production, 8 h, HMAC-signed). 401 for an unknown account. Also how the UI switches account.
Public: sign out. Clears the session cookie.

The signed-in user (from the session cookie), every user for the account switcher, the shop name, its refund policy, and aiStub (true when AI_STUB=1: AI answers come from keyword rules, not a model). Every route except /api/accounts and /api/session needs a valid session: 401 without one. Every POST must be Content-Type: application/json (415 otherwise).

response.policy: object { returnWindowDays, lostAfterDays, agentLimit, historyWindowDays, historyWarnAt }

description: Every order. Wrapped in { orders } — not a bare array.

items.items: array of { sku, name, qty, unitPrice }

description: Every refund, newest first, each with approveBlocker: why the acting user can't approve it (null if they can). Wrapped in { refunds }.

items.amount: number (EUR, computed by the server from the order — never sent by the client)
items.ai: object { feature: 'read' | 'plan', traceId, model, promptVersion, edited: boolean } (optional; only on refunds created from an AI draft)
items.history: array of { at: ISO timestamp, by: user id, role, action: 'created' | 'approved' | 'rejected', traceId (optional), note (optional) }: the audit trail, append-only, written by the server

description: Create a refund from a reviewed draft. Agents only (403 otherwise). There is no amount field: the server prices from the order and runs every policy check; status is 'blocked' if any check blocks. Returns 201.

body.ai: object { feature, traceId, model, promptVersion, edited } (optional; the provenance from the read-request / plan-refunds response, kept only when source is 'ai')

response.refund: object, same shape as an item of GET /api/refunds

description: Price and check a draft without saving it — what the review screen shows on every change.
Approve a pending refund. 403 if the role doesn't allow it (agent over 100 €, supervisor on their own); 409 if it's blocked or not pending.

response.refund: object, same shape as an item of GET /api/refunds

description: Reject a refund: the agent who created it, or a supervisor. 409 if already approved or rejected.

response.refund: object, same shape as an item of GET /api/refunds

description: AI: read a customer email or a receipt photo/PDF into a draft. Agents only. Send exactly one of message or file. 413/415 on file limits, 502 { kind: 'invalid_output' | 'upstream' } on model failure, 503 when switched off, 429 over 20 AI calls/min. 429 { kind: 'budget' } once the user has spent their daily AI budget (DAILY_AI_BUDGET_USD, default 1 USD).

body.message: object { from, subject, body } (optional; body ≤ 5000 chars)
body.file: object { name, mediaType: image/png | image/jpeg | image/webp | application/pdf, data: base64 } (optional; ≤ 3 MB)

response.report: object { isRefundRequest, orderId, items, reason, refundShipping, requestedAmount, summary }
response.draft: object, a draft with items { sku, qty, from } (optional; absent when not a refund request)
response.provenance: object { feature: 'read' | 'plan', traceId, model, promptVersion }: which AI call produced this; send it back as the draft's ai field

description: AI: answer a question about orders and refunds as a Server-Sent Events stream (send Accept: text/event-stream). The server first retrieves the records relevant to the question (ids, customer, status, reason, product; all records when nothing matches) and the model sees only those. Events: status, delta { text }, result { citations, invalidCitations, grounded, abstained, retrieved }, done, or error { status, error, kind }. 429 { kind: 'budget' } once the user has spent their daily AI budget (DAILY_AI_BUDGET_USD, default 1 USD).

body.question: string (≤ 500 chars)
body.history: array of { role: 'user' | 'assistant', content } (optional; last 6 kept)

description: AI: propose refunds for an instruction (e.g. 'refund every parcel that never arrived'). Agents only. Creates nothing: every proposal is already policy-checked; blocked ones come with reasons. 429 { kind: 'budget' } once the user has spent their daily AI budget (DAILY_AI_BUDGET_USD, default 1 USD).

response.proposals: array of { draft, amount, checks, why }
response.truncated: boolean (true if the model hit its token limit)
response.provenance: object { feature: 'read' | 'plan', traceId, model, promptVersion }: which AI call produced this; send it back as the draft's ai field

description: A 👍/👎 on an AI result, joined to its model call by trace id (Ask: the done frame's traceId; read / plan: provenance.traceId). Any role. Logged as a [feedback] line and counted in /api/ai-metrics.
Per AI feature, since the server started: feedback, what happened to AI drafts (created, edited first, approved, rejected) and unusable model outputs. Supervisors only (403 otherwise).

response.features: object { read, ask, plan }, each { feedback: { up, down }, created, edited, approved, rejected, failures, byModel: { [model]: { created, edited, approved, rejected } } } (byModel compares a canary model with the stable one)
